module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  ena,
    input  [1:0] amount,
    input  [63:0] data,
    output reg [63:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            // Load data directly, active high
            q <= data;
        end else if (ena) begin
            // Shift operation selected by amount
            case (amount)
                2'b00: q <= {q[62:0], 1'b0};       // Shift left by 1 bit
                2'b01: q <= {q[55:0], 8'b0};       // Shift left by 8 bits
                2'b10: q <= {q[63], q[63:1]};      // Arithmetic right shift by 1 bit
                2'b11: q <= { {8{q[63]}}, q[63:8] }; // Arithmetic right shift by 8 bits
                default: q <= q;                    // Default: hold value
            endcase
        end
        // If both load and ena are low, q holds its previous value
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset)
        q <= 4'b0001;          // synchronous active-high reset to 1
    else if (q == 4'b1010)    // when count reaches 10 (binary 1010)
        q <= 4'b0001;         // wrap around to 1
    else
        q <= q + 1;           // normal up-count
end
